sentences.text: First application was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 10.12.2021.
Second bail application was also dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer in case there is no substantive progress in the trial within a period of four months.
This application has been filed primarily on the ground of delay in the trial.

It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since 19.3.2021 and after examination of the material witnesses no substantive progress in the trial has been made though 9 out of total 17 witnesses have been examined.
It is submitted that for failure of appearance of the prosecution witnesses the applicant cannot be kept in jail for an indefinite period.
The prayer is opposed by learned counsel for respondent/State who has prayed for rejection of the application.
The record indicates that 9 out of total 17 witnesses have been examined before the trial court and they were the material witnesses and now only a few witnesses remained to be examined.

Thus considering the period of custody of the applicant which is now almost two years, I deem it fit and proper to direct the trial court to make all possible endeavours and to ensure that trial is itself concluded preferably within a period of 4 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
In case the trial is not so concluded the applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail.
With the aforesaid direction, the application stands disposed off.

(PRANAY VERMA) SS/-
